Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Gate team-b.

Sprint goal: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically, and there are 5 days left in the sprint.
Daniel, please share your update. What did you finish, what is next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: you finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two yesterday, you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests today, and nothing is blocking you.

Daniel, task 19, Prepare reconciliation report for audit, is past its due date. What is the new date?
The reconciliation report is at risk. I'll start it right after the idempotency keys, and flag it if it slips.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: The reconciliation report is at risk. I'll start it right after the idempotency keys, and flag it if it slips.

Daniel, story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Daniel, for the summary page being on hold until the idempotency keys are in, who can help unblock this?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.

Thanks, Daniel.

Maya, what did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline and I’ll add it to the parking lot, then Maya please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for bug 12 with the sandbox gateway timeouts and your need for access to the platform team’s staging gateway, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with him on the staging access today.

story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker and your commitment: the PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review, and you’ll chase them today; blockers will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya.

Admin, please share your update. What did you finish, what is next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.

Admin, I’ve noted you finished refund API tests, you’re continuing the payment retry story today, and you have no blockers.

Task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slipped because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
Admin, for the sandbox being down and delaying the retry load test, who can help unblock this?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted the blocker: Waiting on the sandbox from the platform team, and it will be flagged for follow-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Blockers were raised: the summary page will resume once idempotency keys are in, Maya is blocked on bug 12 due to sandbox gateway timeouts and needs access to the platform team’s staging gateway, the PCI scan exceptions are waiting on security review, and the sandbox was down with follow-on work waiting on the platform team. A side discussion about the gateway timeouts was parked for offline between Daniel Park and Admin. One item was flagged as not covered: task 15 is stale, and the owner will get a follow-up about it. Follow-ups, including any for absences or non-responses if they occur, are coming in Teams—thanks everyone.
